    <title>Jetload - مركز التحميل الإحترافي</title>
    <meta name="referrer" content="unsafe-url">

    <script type="text/javascript" src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.6.0.min.js"></script>
    <style>
        :root{--dark-bg:#1a1c23;--card-bg:#252830;--header-bg:#21232a;--primary-accent:#00aeff;--secondary-accent:#6c5ce7;--text-primary:#fff;--text-secondary:#a9a9b3;--border-color:#3a3f4b}
        body{background-color:var(--dark-bg);color:var(--text-primary);font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;margin:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:100vh;text-align:center}
        .site-header{background-color:var(--header-bg);padding:20px 30px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-color);box-shadow:0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,.2);width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center}
        .logo-link{text-decoration:none}.logo{font-size:2.5em;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-primary);letter-spacing:2px;margin:0}.logo span{background:-webkit-linear-gradient(45deg,var(--primary-accent),var(--secondary-accent));-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent}
        main{flex-grow:1;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;padding:20px}
        .download-card{background-color:var(--card-bg);padding:30px 40px;border-radius:15px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5);width:90%;max-width:450px;border:1px solid var(--border-color);animation:card-enter .6s ease-out}
        @keyframes card-enter{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(25px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
        .file-icon{width:60px;height:60px;margin:0 auto 20px;fill:var(--primary-accent)}
        .file-info h2{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:1.5em;font-weight:600}
        .file-info p{margin:0 0 30px;color:var(--text-secondary);font-size:1em}
        .countdown-wrapper{position:relative;width:120px;height:120px;margin:0 auto 20px}
        #countdown-circle{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;background:conic-gradient(var(--primary-accent) 0deg,var(--card-bg) 0deg);transition:background .2s linear}
        #countdown-number{width:100px;height:100px;background:var(--dark-bg);border-radius:50%;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;font-size:2.5em;font-weight:600;color:var(--primary-accent)}
        .info-text{color:var(--text-secondary);margin-bottom:30px}
        .download-btn{display:none;padding:15px 40px;background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,var(--primary-accent) 0%,var(--secondary-accent) 100%);color:var(--text-primary);text-decoration:none;font-size:1.2em;font-weight:600;border:none;border-radius:8px;transition:all .3s ease;box-shadow:0 4px 15px rgba(108,92,231,.4);transform:scale(.9);opacity:0}
        .download-btn.visible{display:inline-block;transform:scale(1);opacity:1}
        .download-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(108,92,231,.6)}
        .site-footer{padding:20px;font-size:.9em;color:var(--text-secondary);background-color:var(--header-bg);border-top:1px solid var(--border-color)}
        .site-footer a{color:var(--primary-accent);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600}
    </style>
</head>
